turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Good afternoon, Rachel. Daniel Lim here. Thanks for setting aside a few minutes for the call. I'm at my desk and have your file open. We can keep this brief, so you won't need to come down to the branch.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Hi Daniel, thank you. Telephone is much easier for me, especially between meetings. Let me give you my particulars first. [[EV_010]] [[EV_011]]

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Thank you, Rachel. I'll keep the discussion concise rather than go through a long presentation. From our earlier conversation, I've recorded the following. [[EV_001]] [[EV_005]]

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: [[EV_006]] I've got a little time now, but I need to leave for another appointment shortly. Please keep to the main points.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Before I give you the details, a quick administrative point. I'm travelling quite a bit at the moment, and correspondence gets scattered across different folders. I'd rather have everything accessible through the usual secure channel than carry papers around.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: We can keep the correspondence in the usual secure channel. You can access it while you're away. For general questions about where to find documents, you can also contact me by telephone instead of making a branch visit.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: That's convenient. I keep my personal paperwork separate from the company files, so I don't want bank correspondence buried among the office emails. Anyway, here are my details for today. [[EV_012]] [[EV_017]] [[EV_013]] [[EV_014]]

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Thank you. On the correspondence side, I'll leave the office contact arrangements as they are. There's no need to involve your staff in our telephone discussions. You can reach me directly for help navigating the document inbox.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Thank you, Rachel. For any follow-up contact, is an afternoon call generally easier while you're travelling, or would you rather we arrange a time by secure message first?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Please message first. My calendar changes quite often, and sometimes I'm in a taxi or at a meeting when the phone rings. If we agree on a slot, I can find somewhere quiet and have my documents ready.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Sure, we'll arrange a suitable slot through the secure channel. If you need help locating correspondence, let me know which section you're looking at. Please don't send passwords or access codes in a message.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Okay, that arrangement works for my schedule. I'll check the inbox when I'm back at the hotel, rather than try to sort things out on my phone between appointments. Thanks for keeping the call short.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: You're welcome. I'll let you get to your appointment. Have a good afternoon, Rachel, and safe travels.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Thanks, Daniel. Speak another time. Bye.
